## Principle

Prose that carries a transferable reason and runs comfortably past the minimum word count the
gate requires, so that a failure in another fixture is never ambiguous about its cause.

## Do not copy

More real prose stating what specifically must not be lifted, also past the minimum word count
so this control never fails for a reason unrelated to what it is controlling for.
